test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 12th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: How many approximate kgs of rice costing Rs 60 per kg must be mixed with 10 kg of rice costing Rs 40 per kg so that a 15 percent profit may be obtained by selling the mixture at Rs 57.50 per kg?
solution:
**Given:**

Cost of rice A = Rs 60 per kg

Cost of rice B = Rs 40 per kg

Quantity of rice B = 10 kg

Selling price of the mixture = Rs 57.50 per kg

Profit percentage = 15%

**Formula Used:**

Cost price of mixture = Selling price ÷ (1 + Profit Percentage)

Weighted average formula: (Quantity A × Cost A + Quantity B × Cost B) ÷ (Quantity A + Quantity B) = Cost price of mixture

**Calculation:**

⇒ Cost price of mixture = 57.50 ÷ (1 + 15/100)

⇒ Cost price of mixture = 57.50 ÷ 1.15

⇒ Cost price of mixture = Rs 50 per kg

Using the weighted average formula:

⇒ (x × 60 + 10 × 40) ÷ (x + 10) = 50

⇒ (60x + 400) ÷ (x + 10) = 50

⇒ 60x + 400 = 50(x + 10)

⇒ 60x + 400 = 50x + 500

⇒ 60x - 50x = 500 - 400

⇒ 10x = 100

⇒ x = 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10 kg.**
